qe: Which of the following political associations was established in 1836 by the close associates of Raja Rammohan Roy, marking an early step in organized socio-political expression in Bengal?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा राजनीतिक संघ 1836 में राजा राममोहन राय के करीबी सहयोगियों द्वारा स्थापित किया गया था, जो बंगाल में संगठित सामाजिक-राजनीतिक अभिव्यक्ति का एक प्रारंभिक चरण था?
oe: British Indian Association
Bangabhasha Prakasika Sabha
Bengal British India Society
Landholders' Society
oh: ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन
बंगभाषा प्रकाशिका सभा
बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी
लैंडहोल्डर्स सोसाइटी
e:
Early nineteenth-century Bengal mein Raja Rammohan Roy ke followers ne administrative policies par charcha karne ke liye organized political bodies establish karna shuru kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because British Indian Association 1851 mein Landholders' Society aur Bengal British India Society ke merger se form hui thi.

• Option 2 is Correct because Bangabhasha Prakasika Sabha ko 1836 mein Raja Rammohan Roy ke close associates aur followers (jaise Gauri Shankar Tarkabagish) ne establish kiya tha. Ye Bengal ki earliest organized public associations mein se ek thi jiska main purpose administrative measures ko review karna, government policies par discuss karna aur constitutional methods se public grievances ko address karwana tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Bengal British India Society 1843 mein George Thompson ki advice par bani thi taaki common logon ki socio-economic conditions ka information collect aur circulate kiya ja sake.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Landholders' Society (Zamindari Association) baad mein 1838 mein bani thi, jise Dwarkanath Tagore, Radhakanta Deb aur Prasanna Kumar Tagore ne landlords ke class interests protect karne ke liye banaya tha.

qe: The Zamindari Association, which was founded in Bengal to safeguard the class interests of the landlords, is historically more popular under which name?
qh: जमींदारी एसोसिएशन, जिसकी स्थापना बंगाल में जमींदारों के वर्गीय हितों की रक्षा के लिए की गई थी, ऐतिहासिक रूप से किस नाम से अधिक लोकप्रिय है?
oe: Indian League
Landholders' Society
Bengal British India Society
British Indian Association
oh: इंडियन लीग
लैंडहोल्डर्स सोसाइटी
बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी
ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन
e:
Bengal mein zamindaron ke hiton aur Permanent Settlement ki raksha ke liye bani sanstha ne Bharat mein organized constitutional agitation ki neev rakhi thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Indian League kafi baad mein 1875 mein Sisir Kumar Ghosh ne banayi thi taaki middle class mein nationalism stimulate kiya ja sake.

• Option 2 is Correct because Zamindari Association, jise Calcutta mein 1838 mein prominent landlords jaise Dwarkanath Tagore aur Radhakanta Deb ne banaya tha, historically 'Landholders' Society' ke naam se popular hui. Bhale hi iska primary focus sectional tha—wealthy landlords ke interests aur Permanent Settlement ko protect karna—lekin isne India mein organized constitutional agitation ki shuruaat mark ki.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Bengal British India Society 1843 mein broader public welfare perspective ke sath form hui thi, jo Landholders' Society ke aristocratic landlord focus se alag thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because British Indian Association 1851 mein tab bani jab Landholders' Society aur Bengal British India Society aapas mein merge hui.

qe: What was the primary stated objective behind the establishment of the Bengal British India Society in 1843?
qh: 1843 में 'बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी' की स्थापना के पीछे घोषित प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To directly manage the competitive civil services examination tracking metrics in London
To launch an immediate armed rebellion against the local zamindari land systems
To exclusively safeguard and legally defend the financial revenue models of the wealthy landlords
The collection and dissemination of information relating to the actual condition of the people of British India
oh: लंदन में प्रतियोगी सिविल सेवा परीक्षा ट्रैकिंग मेट्रिक्स को सीधे प्रबंधित करना
स्थानीय जमींदारी भूमि व्यवस्था के खिलाफ तत्काल सशस्त्र विद्रोह शुरू करना
विशेष रूप से अमीर जमींदारों के वित्तीय राजस्व मॉडल की रक्षा और कानूनी रूप से बचाव करना
ब्रिटिश भारत के लोगों की वास्तविक स्थिति से संबंधित जानकारी का संग्रह और प्रसार करना
e:
1840s ke dauran Bengal mein aam janta ki samajik-aarthik sthiti ki jankari jutaney aur peaceful advocacy ke liye naye sangathan banaye gaye the.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Civil services examinations ka management entirely British colonial administration karta tha, na ki 1843 ki Indian political societies.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Society peaceful, constitutional aur loyalist methods mein vishwas rakhti thi; isne armed rebellion ya violent uprising ko strictly reject kiya.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Landed aristocracy ke class interests defend karna Landholders' Society (1838) ka specific agenda tha, Bengal British India Society ka nahi.

• Option 4 is Correct because Bengal British India Society ko 1843 mein George Thompson, Dwarkanath Tagore aur unke associates ke efforts se establish kiya gaya tha. Iska primary objective British India ke logon ki actual socio-economic conditions se related accurate information collect aur peacefully disseminate karna tha, taaki law ke framework ke andar public welfare aur rights ke liye advocacy ki ja sake.

qe: In 1851, the Landholders' Society and the Bengal British India Society merged to form a unified organization. What was the name of this newly created body?
qh: 1851 में, लैंडहोल्डर्स सोसाइटी और बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी का आपस में विलय हो गया। इस नवगठित संस्था का नाम क्या था?
oe: Indian League
East India Association
Indian Association of Calcutta
British Indian Association
oh: इंडियन लीग
ईस्ट इंडिया एसोसिएशन
इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता
ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन
e:
East India Company ke 1853 Charter renewal se pehle Bharatiya netaon ne ek sanjukt political platform banane ke liye purani sansthaon ka vilay kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Indian League 1875 mein Sisir Kumar Ghosh dwara establish ki gayi thi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because East India Association 1866 mein Dadabhai Naoroji dwara London mein form hui thi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Indian Association of Calcutta ko 1876 mein Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose ne banaya tha.

• Option 4 is Correct because October 1851 mein Landholders' Society aur Bengal British India Society ka merger hua jisse British Indian Association of Calcutta form hui. Radhakanta Deb iske first President bane aur Debendranath Tagore ne Secretary ke roop mein serve kiya. Is body ne East India Company ke upcoming 1853 Charter renewal ke context mein Parliament ko petitions bhejne ke liye ek combined platform provide kiya.

qe: The British Indian Association sent a petition to the British Parliament regarding the Charter renewal. Which of their constitutional demands was partially conceded by the Charter Act of 1853?
qh: ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन ने चार्टर नवीनीकरण के संबंध में ब्रिटिश संसद को एक याचिका भेजी थी। उनकी कौन सी संवैधानिक मांग 1853 के चार्टर अधिनियम द्वारा आंशिक रूप से स्वीकार की गई थी?
oe: The absolute and complete separation of the executive from judicial functions in districts
The immediate universal abolition of all salt, stamp, and abkari excise duties
The addition of six members to the Governor-General’s council for legislative purposes
The total Indianization of all superior administrative civil service positions
oh: जिलों में न्यायिक कार्यों से कार्यपालिका का पूर्ण और संपूर्ण पृथक्करण
सभी नमक, स्टांप और आबकारी शुल्कों का तत्काल सार्वभौमिक उन्मूलन
विधायी उद्देश्यों के लिए गवर्नर-जनरल की परिषद में छह नए सदस्यों को जोड़ना
सभी उच्च प्रशासनिक सिविल सेवा पदों का पूर्ण भारतीयकरण
e:
Charter Act of 1853 ke madhyam se Governor-General ki executive aur legislative responsibilities ko pehli baar alag roop mein structure kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Executive aur judicial functions ko separate karne ki demand early nationalists ne baar-baar uthayi thi, par ise 1853 Act mein accept nahi kiya gaya tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Association ne salt, abkari aur stamp duties mein relief maanga tha, par British government ne fiscal demands reject kar di thin.

• Option 3 is Correct because Charter renewal se pehle British Indian Association ne ek petition submit ki jisme popular character ki separate legislature ki demand thi. Charter Act of 1853 ne ise partially accept karte hue Governor-General ki Executive Council ko law-making purposes ke liye 6 additional 'legislative councillors' se expand kar diya, jisse Legislative Council create hui.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 1853 Act ne civil services ke liye open competition introduce kiya, par superior posts ke complete Indianization ka provision nahi diya.

qe: Dadabhai Naoroji organized the East India Association in 1866 to discuss the Indian question and influence public opinion abroad. In which city was this association founded?
qh: दादाभाई नौरोजी ने भारतीय प्रश्न पर चर्चा करने और विदेशों में जनमत को प्रभावित करने के लिए 1866 में ईस्ट इंडिया एसोसिएशन का गठन किया था। इस एसोसिएशन की स्थापना किस शहर में हुई थी?
oe: Bombay
London
Calcutta
Madras
oh: बॉम्बे
लंदन
कलकत्ता
मद्रास
e:
Bharatiya rashtravadiyon ne British janta aur sansad ke beech Bharat ke paksh mein public opinion banane ke liye videsh mein sangathan sthapit kiye the.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Bombay mein Bombay Association (1852) aur Bombay Presidency Association (1885) establish hui thin.

• Option 2 is Correct because East India Association ko Dadabhai Naoroji ne 1866 mein London mein establish kiya tha. Iska primary motive Indian grievances aur economic issues ko highlight karna tha taaki British Parliament ke members aur British public opinion ko Indian welfare ke favor mein influence kiya ja sake. Baad mein iski branches Bombay, Calcutta aur Madras mein bhi open hui thin.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Calcutta mein Landholders' Society (1838), British Indian Association (1851) aur Indian Association (1876) bani thin.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Madras mein Madras Native Association (1852) aur Madras Mahajan Sabha (1884) active thin.

qe: The 'Indian League' was established in 1875 with the primary object of stimulating a sense of nationalism and encouraging political education. Who was its founder?
qh: 1875 में 'इंडियन लीग' की स्थापना राष्ट्रवाद की भावना को जगाने और राजनीतिक शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने के प्राथमिक उद्देश्य से की गई थी। इसके संस्थापक कौन थे?
oe: Sisir Kumar Ghosh
W.C. Bonnerjee
Surendranath Banerjea
Ananda Mohan Bose
oh: शिशिर कुमार घोष
डब्ल्यू. सी. बनर्जी
सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी
आनंद मोहन बोस
e:
1870s ke dashak mein madhyam varg ke andar rashtravadi chetna aur rajnitik shiksha ko badhava dene ke liye naye sangathan bane the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Indian League ko 1875 mein Calcutta mein Sisir Kumar Ghosh (Amrita Bazar Patrika ke founder-editor) aur Sambhu Charan Mukherjee ne establish kiya tha. Iska declared objective logon mein nationalism ki feeling stimulate karna aur political education aur civic consciousness promote karna tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee Bengal ke leading barrister the jo 1885 mein Indian National Congress ke first President bane.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose ne 1876 mein broader base wali Indian Association of Calcutta banayi, jisne jaldi hi Indian League ko overshadow kar diya.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Ananda Mohan Bose Surendranath Banerjea ke sath Indian Association ke co-founder the, Indian League ke nahi.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta (or Indian National Association) was founded in 1876 by younger nationalists who were discontented with the pro-landlord policies of older groups. Who were its main architects?
qh: कलकत्ता की इंडियन एसोसिएशन (या इंडियन नेशनल एसोसिएशन) की स्थापना 1876 में उन युवा राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा की गई थी जो पुराने समूहों की जमींदार-समर्थक नीतियों से असंतुष्ट थे। इसके मुख्य वास्तुकार कौन थे?
oe: Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha
M. Viraraghavachariar and P. Anandacharlu
Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Badruddin Tyabji and Pherozshah Mehta
oh: दादाभाई नौरोजी और दिनशा वाचा
एम. वीरराघवाचार्य और पी. आनंदाचार्लू
सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी और आनंद मोहन बोस
बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी और फिरोजशाह मेहता
e:
British Indian Association ki zamindar-pakshadhar neetiyon ke virodh mein yuva rashtravadiyon ne ek mazboot akhil Bharatiya sangathan banaya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Dadabhai Naoroji aur Dinshaw Wacha Bombay-based leaders the jo East India Association aur Bombay Presidency Association se jude the.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because M. Viraraghavachariar aur P. Anandacharlu 1884 mein bani Madras Mahajan Sabha ke leaders the.

• Option 3 is Correct because Indian Association of Calcutta (jise Indian National Association bhi kaha jata hai) ko 26 July 1876 ko young middle-class nationalists ne form kiya tha jiske main leaders Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose the. Ye log British Indian Association ke conservative aur pro-landlord outlook se dissatisfied the aur ek strong all-India political movement build karna chahte the.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Badruddin Tyabji aur Pherozshah Mehta 1885 mein bani Bombay Presidency Association ke key founders the.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta actively launched a major national campaign in 1877 to protest against which regressive administrative step taken by the colonial government?
qh: इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने 1877 में औपनिवेशिक सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए किस प्रतिगामी प्रशासनिक कदम का विरोध करने के लिए एक बड़ा राष्ट्रीय अभियान शुरू किया था?
oe: The complete legal separation of the judicial benches from provincial executive oversight
The reduction of the maximum age limit for candidates of the Indian Civil Service examination
The levying of an automatic internal excise transit duty on all native cotton mills
The mandatory use of English instead of Persian across all local lower subdivisions
oh: प्रांतीय कार्यकारी निरीक्षण से न्यायिक पीठों का पूर्ण कानूनी पृथक्करण
भारतीय सिविल सेवा परीक्षा के उम्मीदवारों के लिए अधिकतम आयु सीमा में कटौती
सभी देशी सूती मिलों पर एक स्वचालित आंतरिक उत्पाद पारगमन शुल्क लगाना
सभी स्थानीय निचले उप-प्रभागों में फारसी के स्थान पर अंग्रेजी का अनिवार्य उपयोग
e:
Colonial shasan dwara Bharatiya prathiyon ko prashasanik sevayein se door rakhne ke liye uthaye gaye kadamon ke khilaf rashtravyapi virodh hua tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Judiciary aur executive ka separation nationalists ki continuous demand thi, colonial state dwara 1877 mein enact kiya gaya koi regressive measure nahi.

• Option 2 is Correct because 1877 mein Lord Salisbury (Secretary of State for India) ne Indian Civil Service (ICS) examination ke liye maximum age limit ko 21 years se reduce karke 19 years kar diya tha taaki Indian students successfully compete na kar sakein. Indian Association ne iske against country-wide 'Civil Service Agitation' organize kiya, jisme Surendranath Banerjea ne different cities ka extensive tour karke public opinion build kiya.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Cotton duties par protest Lord Lytton ki 1879 tariff policies ke around hua tha, 1877 ka primary issue age limit reduction tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Persian ki jagah English ko administrative language Lord William Bentinck ke time 1835 mein banaya ja chuka tha.

qe: To broadbase its membership and attract the poorer and working sections of society, how did the Indian Association of Calcutta structure its institutional framework?
qh: अपनी सदस्यता को व्यापक बनाने और समाज के गरीब तथा श्रमिक वर्गों को आकर्षित करने के लिए, इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने अपने संस्थागत ढांचे को कैसे व्यवस्थित किया?
oe: It kept its official membership fee low and opened branches in remote towns
It operated as a completely secret society that avoided any public political propaganda
It required all members to hold highly technical engineering degrees from London
It restricted its leadership positions exclusively to the wealthy regional zamindars
oh: इसने अपनी आधिकारिक सदस्यता शुल्क को कम रखा और दूरदराज के कस्बों में शाखाएं खोलीं
यह पूरी तरह से एक गुप्त समाज के रूप में संचालित होता था जो किसी भी सार्वजनिक राजनीतिक प्रचार से बचता था
इसके लिए सभी सदस्यों के पास लंदन से अत्यधिक तकनीकी इंजीनियरिंग डिग्री होना आवश्यक था
इसने अपने नेतृत्व के पदों को विशेष रूप से धनी क्षेत्रीय जमींदारों तक ही सीमित रखा
e:
Purani elitist sansthaon ke viprit, naye rashtravadi sangathanon ne aam janta aur madhyam varg ko jodne ke liye subscription aur reach mein badlav kiye the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Earlier aristocratic organizations (jaise British Indian Association jisme annual subscription ₹50 tha) ke opposite, Indian Association of Calcutta ne apna annual membership fee sirf ₹5 (aur rural logon ke liye aur bhi kam) rakha. Iske alawa isne Bengal aur northern India ke district towns aur villages mein branches open karke middle aur lower-middle classes ko active political platform provide kiya.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Association ek open aur constitutional political body thi jo public meetings, petitions aur press campaigns run karti thi, secret society nahi thi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Membership ke liye koi foreign technical degree required nahi thi; ye patriotic aur educated citizens ke liye openly accessible thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Indian Association specifically isliye bani thi taaki wealthy zamindars ki monopoly ko break karke educated middle class aur masses ko represent kiya ja sake.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta sponsored a landmark historic All India Conference in Calcutta from December 28 to 30, 1883. Why is this conference considered a critical forerunner of the Indian National Congress?
qh: इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने 28 से 30 दिसंबर, 1883 तक कलकत्ता में एक ऐतिहासिक अखिल भारतीय सम्मेलन (All India Conference) को प्रायोजित किया। इस सम्मेलन को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का एक महत्वपूर्ण अग्रदूत क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: It drafted the legal civil code metrics that completely replaced all traditional shastras
It was funded entirely by the British Chamber of Commerce to manage corporate tax collections
It formally introduced a resolution demanding the immediate armed partition of the country
It was the first major national gathering that brought together more than a hundred political delegates from different parts of India
oh: इसने कानूनी नागरिक संहिता मेट्रिक्स का मसौदा तैयार किया जिसने सभी पारंपरिक शास्त्रों को पूरी तरह से बदल दिया
यह कॉर्पोरेट कर संग्रह का प्रबंधन करने के लिए ब्रिटिश चैंबर ऑफ कॉमर्स द्वारा पूरी तरह से वित्तपोषित था
इसने औपचारिक रूप से देश के तत्काल सशस्त्र विभाजन की मांग करते हुए एक प्रस्ताव पेश किया
यह पहला बड़ा राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन था जिसने भारत के विभिन्न हिस्सों से सौ से अधिक राजनीतिक प्रतिनिधियों को एक साथ लाया
e:
1885 mein Congress ki sthapna se pehle rashtriya star par netaon ko ekjut karne ke prayas shuru ho chuke the.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Conference ka focus civil liberties, representative councils aur administrative reforms par tha, personal civil laws codify karne par nahi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Is conference ko Indian nationalist leaders ne independently organize aur finance kiya tha, British Chamber of Commerce ne nahi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Conference national unity aur integration ko promote karne ke liye thi, armed conflict ya partition ke liye nahi.

• Option 4 is Correct because December 1883 mein Ananda Mohan Bose aur Surendranath Banerjea ne Calcutta mein Indian National Conference organize ki, jisme Bengal, Bombay, Madras aur Northern India ke different associations se 100+ delegates ne participate kiya. Ye all-India scale par national issues par deliberate karne wala first pan-Indian gathering tha, jisne 1885 mein banne wali Indian National Congress ke liye ek operational prototype aur direct forerunner ka kaam kiya.

qe: The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha was founded in 1867 with the progressive objective of serving as an active communication bridge between the government and the people. Who was its chief mentor?

e:
London mein British janta aur sansad tak Bharatiya rashtravadi vicharon ko pahunchane ke liye ek vishisht patrika shuru ki gayi thi.

• Option 1 is Correct because 1889 mein London mein Indian National Congress ki British Committee establish ki gayi thi jiske key leaders William Wedderburn, William Digby aur Dadabhai Naoroji the. Is committee ne 1890 se apna official organ journal 'India' publish karna start kiya taaki British parliamentarians aur public ko Indian issues aur colonial exploitation ke baare mein inform kiya ja sake.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Satya Prakash 1852 mein Karsandas Mulji dwara started Gujarati reform journal tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Darpan 1832 mein Balshastri Jambhekar dwara start kiya gaya pioneering Marathi newspaper tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Rast Goftar 1851 mein Dadabhai Naoroji ne Parsi socio-religious reform ke liye Bombay mein shuru kiya tha.

qe: The early Moderate nationalists carefully dissected the political economy of British imperialism and put forward the 'Drain Theory'. Who were the primary authors of this economic critique?
qh: शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने ब्रिटिश साम्राज्यवाद की राजनीतिक अर्थव्यवस्था का सावधानीपूर्वक विश्लेषण किया और 'ड्रेन थ्योरी' (Drain Theory) को पेश किया। इस आर्थिक आलोचना के प्राथमिक लेखक कौन थे?
oe: Dadabhai Naoroji, R.C. Dutt, and Dinshaw Wacha
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, and Sisir Kumar Ghosh
W.C. Bonnerjee, A.O. Hume, and Lord Dufferin
Badruddin Tyabji, Pherozshah Mehta, and K.T. Telang
oh: दादाभाई नौरोजी, आर. सी. दत्त और दिनशा वाचा
सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी, आनंद मोहन बोस और शिशिर कुमार घोष
डब्ल्यू. सी. बनर्जी, ए. ओ. ह्यूम और लॉर्ड डफरिन
बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी, फिरोजशाह मेहता और के. टी. तेलंग
e:
British aarthik shoshan aur Bharat se dhan ki bahaav ki prakriya ko naramdaliya aarthik vidwano ne tathyatmak roop se prastut kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because British colonial economic exploitation ki systematic critique aur 'Drain Theory' ka formulation Dadabhai Naoroji (Poverty and Un-British Rule in India), Romesh Chandra Dutt (R.C. Dutt) (The Economic History of India), Dinshaw Wacha, G.V. Joshi aur M.G. Ranade ne kiya tha. Unhone prove kiya ki British rule India se continuous capital aur resources bina kisi return ke Britain drain kar raha hai, jo Indian poverty ka root cause hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because S.N. Banerjea aur A.M. Bose prominent political agitators the, par primary economic treatises Naoroji aur Dutt ne likhi thin.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because A.O. Hume organizer the aur Lord Dufferin Viceroy the jinhone Congress criticism ko oppose kiya tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Tyabji, Mehta aur Telang mainly legal-constitutional matters mein leading the.

qe: Which of the following fiscal demands was continuously raised by the Moderate nationalists in their annual resolutions to reduce the deprivation characterizing Indian rural life?
qh: भारतीय ग्रामीण जीवन की अभावग्रस्तता को कम करने के लिए नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा अपने वार्षिक प्रस्तावों में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वित्तीय मांग लगातार उठाई गई थी?
oe: The absolute expansion of private land sales and total privatization of forests
Reduction in land revenue, abolition of the salt tax, and direct government aid to modern industries
The complete removal of all technical engineering subjects from local colleges
Levying a high transit duty on consumer goods consumed by the poorest sections
oh: निजी भूमि बिक्री का पूर्ण विस्तार और वनों का पूर्ण निजीकरण
भू-राजस्व में कमी, नमक कर का उन्मूलन, और आधुनिक उद्योगों को प्रत्यक्ष सरकारी सहायता
स्थानीय कॉलेजों से सभी तकनीकी इंजीनियरिंग विषयों को पूरी तरह से हटाना
सबसे गरीब वर्गों द्वारा उपभोग की जाने वाली उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं पर उच्च पारगमन शुल्क लगाना
e:
Early Moderate nationalists ne British colonial economic exploitation ke khilaf kisanon aur aam janta ke hiton ke liye consistent financial demands uthayi thin.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Moderates ne forest privatization aur tribal/peasant rights ke violation ka koda virodh kiya tha.

• Option 2 is Correct because Moderate nationalists ne annual Congress sessions mein consistent financial demands raise ki thin: agricultural land revenue mein heavy reduction, oppressive salt tax ka total abolition, military expenditure mein reduction, irrigation facilities ka expansion, aur Indian indigenous modern industries ko nurture karne ke liye tariff protection aur state credit support.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Nationalists ne India mein modern scientific aur technical engineering education ke expansion ki demand ki thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Moderates mass consumption goods par internal transit duties aur excise taxes abolish karne ke favor mein the.

qe: How many total Indian members were nominated to the Imperial Legislative Council in the thirty-year span between 1862 and 1892, reflecting its unrepresentative structural layout?
qh: 1862 और 1892 के बीच तीस साल की अवधि में इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल में कुल कितने भारतीय सदस्यों को नामांकित किया गया था, जो इसके अप्रतिनिधिक संरचनात्मक लेआउट को दर्शाता है?
oe: 100 Indians
45 Indians
15 Indians
72 Indians
oh: 100 भारतीय
45 भारतीय
15 भारतीय
72 भारतीय
e:
Indian Councils Act of 1861 ke tehat Imperial Legislative Council ek highly restrictive aur non-representative nominated body thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 100 Indians is 30-year period ke total nominations ka galat count hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Indian Councils Act of 1861 ke under Central (Imperial) Legislative Council ek extremely narrow aur non-representative nominated body thi. 1862 se 1892 ke 30-year span mein sirf 45 Indians ko non-official members ke roop mein nominate kiya gaya tha, aur inme se majority wealthy landlords, ruling princes aur loyal aristocrats the jo real public interest ko represent nahi karte the.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 15 Indians ek incorrect factual figure hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 72 delegates 1885 ke first Congress session mein attend karne wale representatives the.

qe: Despite the conservative composition of the Imperial Legislative Council before 1892, which handful of independent intellectuals and political figures managed to get nominated and criticize official measures?
qh: 1892 से पहले इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल की रूढ़िवादी संरचना के बावजूद, कौन से स्वतंत्र बुद्धिजीवी और राजनीतिक व्यक्ति नामांकित होने और आधिकारिक उपायों की आलोचना करने में सफल रहे?
oe: M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyer, P. Anandacharlu, and G.P. Verma
Lala Lajpat Rai, Lala Hansraj, Lala Lal Chand, and Swami Shraddhanand
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, Sisir Kumar Ghosh, and Motilal Ghosh
Syed Ahmed Khan, Kristodas Pal, V.N. Mandlik, K.L. Nulkar, and Rashbehari Ghosh
oh: एम. वीरराघवाचार्य, बी. सुब्रमण्यम अय्यर, पी. आनंदाचार्लू और जी. पी. वर्मा
लाला लाजपत राय, लाला हंसराज, लाला लाल चंद और स्वामी श्रद्धानंद
सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी, आनंद मोहन बोस, शिशिर कुमार घोष और मोतीलाल घोष
सैयद अहमद खान, क्रिस्टोदास पाल, वी. एन. मंडलिक, के. एल. नूलकर और रासबिहारी घोष
e:
1892 ke legislative reforms se pehle bhi kuch independent Indian intellectuals ne councils ke bheetar public grievances ko voice di thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ye leaders Madras Presidency aur The Hindu ke work se associated the.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Lala Lajpat Rai aur unke contemporaries Punjab mein Arya Samaj aur later nationalist phase se related the.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Surendranath Banerjea 1892 Act ke baad reformed legislative councils mein enter hue the.

• Option 4 is Correct because 1892 ke reforms se pehle, bhale hi majority nominated members loyalist aristocrats the, par kuch prominent independent intellectuals—jaise Sir Syed Ahmed Khan, Kristodas Pal (Hindoo Patriot ke editor), V.N. Mandlik, K.L. Nulkar, aur Dr. Rashbehari Ghosh—Imperial Legislative Council mein nominate hue aur unhone council floor par public administration aur government policies par critical views present kiye.

qe: From 1885 to 1892, the constitutional demands of the early Moderate nationalists were primarily centered on which two structural areas?
qh: 1885 से 1892 तक, शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों की संवैधानिक मांगें मुख्य रूप से किन दो संरचनात्मक क्षेत्रों पर केंद्रित थीं?
oe: The immediate military partition of the country into separate religious provincial segments
The complete closing of all government-controlled universities and Khalsa schools
Expansion of legislative councils to increase Indian participation, and reform of councils to secure greater control over public finances
The absolute legal transfer of all high court judicial powers to traditional village panchayats
oh: देश का अलग-अलग धार्मिक प्रांतीय खंडों में तत्काल सैन्य विभाजन
सभी सरकारी नियंत्रित विश्वविद्यालयों और खालसा स्कूलों को पूरी तरह से बंद करना
भारतीय भागीदारी बढ़ाने के लिए विधान परिषदों का विस्तार, और सार्वजनिक वित्त पर अधिक नियंत्रण सुरक्षित करने के लिए परिषदों में सुधार
सभी उच्च न्यायालय की न्यायिक शक्तियों का पारंपरिक ग्राम पंचायतों को पूर्ण कानूनी हस्तांतरण
e:
Early Congress ke initial constitutional agitation ka primary focus legislative councils ke democratization aur financial oversight par tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Early Congress secular unity aur pan-India national integration ke liye work karti thi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Nationalists modern scientific aur higher university education ke promotion ke strong advocates the.

• Option 3 is Correct because 1885 se 1892 ke beech early Congress ka constitutional agitation do key structural areas par centered tha: Council Expansion (Central aur Provincial Legislative Councils mein members ki total strength badhana aur elected Indian representatives ko shamil karna) aur Council Reform (Councils ko real powers dena, especially annual financial budget par discussion karne, vote karne aur executive se questions poochne ka right secure karna).

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Moderates High Courts ko dismantle nahi karna chahte the balki executive se judiciary ka separation aur jury trials demand karte the.

qe: What famous democratic political slogan did the early nationalists popularize when demanding greater structural control over the state budget inside the legislative councils?
qh: विधान परिषदों के भीतर राज्य के बजट पर अधिक संरचनात्मक नियंत्रण की मांग करते समय शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादियों ने कौन सा प्रसिद्ध लोकतांत्रिक राजनीतिक नारा लोकप्रिय बनाया था?
oe: No taxation without representation
One religion, one caste, one God for mankind
Back to the Vedas
Educate, Agitate and Organise
oh: प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं तो कर नहीं (No taxation without representation)
मानव जाति के लिए एक धर्म, एक जाति, एक ईश्वर
वेदों की ओर लौटो (Back to the Vedas)
शिक्षित बनो, संघर्ष करो और संगठित हो (Educate, Agitate and Organise)
e:
Early Indian nationalists ne state budget par democratic control aur legislative voting rights secure karne ke liye global democratic slogans ka sahara liya.

• Option 1 is Correct because American War of Independence se inspire hokar early Indian nationalists ne 'No taxation without representation' (प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं तो कर नहीं) ka slogan popularize kiya. Unhone argue kiya ki agar British raj Indian people se taxes collect karta hai, toh legislative councils mein elected Indian representatives ka majority hona chahiye jinke paas budget par vote karne aur modify karne ka sovereign right ho.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because 'One caste, one religion, one God for mankind' Kerala ke social reformer Sri Narayana Guru ne diya tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 'Back to the Vedas' ka call Swami Dayananda Saraswati (Arya Samaj ke founder) ne diya tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 'Educate, Agitate and Organise' Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ka historic call tha.

qe: In the early 1900s, Moderate leaders like Dadabhai Naoroji (1904), Gopal Krishna Gokhale (1905), and Lokmanya Tilak (1906) expanded their constitutional goals to demand self-government on the lines of which specific British colonies?
qh: 1900 के दशक की शुरुआत में, दादाभाई नौरोजी (1904), गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले (1905), और लोकमान्य तिलक (1906) जैसे नरमपंथी नेताओं ने अपनी संवैधानिक मांगों का विस्तार करते हुए किन विशिष्ट ब्रिटिश उपनिवेशों की तर्ज पर स्वशासन (self-government) की मांग की थी?
oe: The American Presidencies
Burma and Ceylon
Ireland and South Africa
Canada and Australia
oh: अमेरिकी प्रेसीडेंसियां
बर्मा और सीलोन
आयरलैंड और दक्षिण अफ्रीका
कनाडा और ऑस्ट्रेलिया
e:
Twentieth century ke shuruat mein Congress ke netaon ne administrative reforms se aage badhkar autonomous self-government (Swaraj) ki mang shuru ki.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because USA 1776 mein sovereign republic ban chuka tha, British dominion nahi tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Burma aur Ceylon direct Crown dependencies the jahan self-governing dominion status nahi tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Irish Home Rule movement ne 1916 mein Tilak aur Annie Besant ko inspire kiya, par 1904–1906 ke official Moderate resolutions mein Canadian aur Australian dominion status ka reference tha.

• Option 4 is Correct because 20th century ke early years mein national movement ka constitutional goal sirf legislative representation se aage badhkar autonomous self-government (Swaraj) tak pahunch gaya. Dadabhai Naoroji (1904 aur 1906 Calcutta presidential address) aur G.K. Gokhale (1905 Benaras presidential address) ne British Empire ke andar Canada aur Australia jaise Self-Governing White Dominions ke model par self-government demand kiya.

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 raised the number of additional non-official members in the Imperial Legislative Council to which standard parameters?
qh: भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1892 ने इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल में अतिरिक्त गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्यों (non-official members) की संख्या को बढ़ाकर कितना कर दिया था?
oe: Exactly seventy-two non-officials to represent all major towns
Ten to sixteen non-officials (instead of six to ten previously)
Six to twelve non-officials instead of none previously
Twenty-four to fifty non-officials (instead of twelve to twenty previously)
oh: सभी प्रमुख शहरों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए ठीक बहत्तर गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्य
दस से सोलह गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्य (पहले के छह से दस के स्थान पर)
पहले के शून्य के स्थान पर छह से बारह गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्य
चौबीस से पचास गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्य (पहले के बारह से बीस के स्थान पर)
e:
Indian Councils Act of 1892 ne Central aur Provincial Legislative Councils mein additional non-official seats ko expand kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 72 count 1885 Congress inaugural session ke delegates ka tha.

• Option 2 is Correct because Indian Councils Act of 1892 ne legislative councils ke size ko expand kiya. Central (Imperial) Legislative Council mein additional non-official members ki strength minimum 10 aur maximum 16 fix ki gayi (jo 1861 Act mein 6 to 10 thi). Iske sath provincial councils (Bengal, Bombay, Madras) mein bhi additional members ki sankhya badha kar maximum 20 ki gayi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 6 to 10 additional members 1861 Act ka provision tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 60 tak members ka expansion 1909 ke Morley-Minto Reforms ke under hua tha.

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 introduced the principle of indirect representation. Who among the following entities was authorized to recommend non-official members for the legislative councils?
qh: भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1892 ने अप्रत्यक्ष प्रतिनिधित्व का सिद्धांत पेश किया। निम्नलिखित में से किस संस्था को विधान परिषदों के लिए गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्यों की सिफारिश करने का अधिकार दिया गया था?
oe: The direct legal body of all low-caste village panchayat heads
Universities, municipalities, zamindars, and chambers of commerce
The executive committee of the All India Kisan Sabha exclusively
The core missionary councils based in London and New York City
oh: सभी निचली जाति के ग्राम पंचायत प्रमुखों का प्रत्यक्ष कानूनी निकाय
विश्वविद्यालय, नगरपालिकाएं, जमींदार और वाणिज्य मंडल (chambers of commerce)
विशेष रूप से अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा की कार्यकारी समिति
लंदन और न्यूयॉर्क शहर में स्थित मुख्य मिशनरी परिषदें
e:
Indian Councils Act 1892 ne statutory roop se indirect election principle ko local bodies ki recommendation ke through implement kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 1892 Act ke tehat Panchayats ko electoral units ke roop mein institutionalize nahi kiya gaya tha.

• Option 2 is Correct because Indian Councils Act 1892 ke text mein 'election' word intentionally avoid kiya gaya tha, par isne ek indirect election mechanism introduce kiya tha. Non-official members ko Governor-General / Governors local representative bodies—jaise Municipalities, District Boards, Universities, Zamindars aur Chambers of Commerce—ki recommendations ke base par nominate karte the.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because All India Kisan Sabha kafi baad mein 1936 mein Swami Sahajanand Saraswati dwara establish hui thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Foreign Christian missionary councils ka council members recommend karne mein koi statutory role nahi tha.

qe: What major structural limitation rendered the 'reformed' Imperial Legislative Council under the Act of 1892 largely ineffective till its next update in 1909?
qh: 1892 के अधिनियम के तहत 'सुधारित' इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल को 1909 में इसके अगले अपडेट तक मुख्य रूप से किस बड़ी संरचनात्मक सीमा ने अप्रभावी बना दिया था?
oe: The non-official Indian members held an absolute two-thirds veto power over executive laws
It was completely barred from discussing any civil administration issues
The official members retained their absolute majority, the budget could not be voted upon, and no amendments could be made to it
The Council was legally forced to meet for only three days in a century
oh: गैर-आधिकारिक भारतीय सदस्यों के पास कार्यकारी कानूनों पर पूर्ण दो-तिहाई वीटो शक्ति थी
इसे किसी भी नागरिक प्रशासन के मुद्दों पर चर्चा करने से पूरी तरह से रोक दिया गया था
आधिकारिक सदस्यों ने अपना पूर्ण बहुमत बनाए रखा, बजट पर मतदान नहीं किया जा सकता था, और इसमें कोई संशोधन नहीं किया जा सकता था
परिषद को कानूनी रूप से एक सदी में केवल तीन दिनों के लिए मिलने के लिए मजबूर किया गया था
e:
1892 ke reforms ke bawajood legislative councils mein official majority aur budget voting par statutory restrictions barqarar the.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Indian members ke paas koi veto power nahi thi; Governor-General ke paas absolute veto power retained thi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Public administration par narrow rules aur prior notice ke under discussion allowed tha.

• Option 3 is Correct because Indian Councils Act of 1892 mein major constitutional limitations the: Colonial executive ka Imperial Council mein overwhelming official majority bana raha; Members ko annual financial budget discuss karne ki permission thi par budget allocations par vote karne ya amendments move karne par strict ban tha; aur Members 6-day prior notice dekar questions pooch sakte the, par supplementary questions poochne par strict prohibition thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because ye ek exaggerated aur factual roop se galat statement hai.

qe: Between its tenure from 1892 to 1909, how many days on average did the 'reformed' Imperial Legislative Council meet in a single year?
qh: 1892 से 1909 तक अपने कार्यकाल के बीच, 'सुधारित' इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल की बैठक एक वर्ष में औसतन कितने दिन हुई थी?
oe: Strictly six days in a year concurrent with autumn cycles
An average of only thirteen days in a year
Exactly forty-five days in a year
More than a hundred days in a year
oh: शरद ऋतु चक्र के साथ समवर्ती रूप से एक वर्ष में कड़ाई से छह दिन
एक वर्ष में औसतन केवल तेरह दिन
एक वर्ष में ठीक पैंतालीस दिन
एक वर्ष में सौ से अधिक दिन
e:
Imperial Legislative Council 1892 reforms ke baad bhi ek symbolic aur procedural body bani rahi jiske annual sittings kaafi kam the.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 6 days annual sitting ka koi official statutory record nahi hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because 1892 se 1909 ke dauran Imperial Legislative Council ke statistical records show karte hain ki council ki meeting saal mein average sirf thirteen days (13 din) hi hoti thi, aur budget debates do-teen din mein conclude ho jati thin. Iske alawa, 24 total members mein se non-official Indian members ki count mushkil se 5 se zyada hoti thi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 45 days is period ke dauran central council ka operational average nahi tha.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 100 din se zyada ke continuous parliamentary sessions post-independence India mein shuru hue.

qe: What moral ground did the Moderate nationalists raise when campaigning for the comprehensive Indianization of the higher administrative government services?
qh: उच्च प्रशासनिक सरकारी सेवाओं के व्यापक भारतीयकरण (Indianization) के लिए अभियान चलाते समय नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने कौन सा नैतिक आधार उठाया था?
oe: That Indians were being heavily discriminated against by being kept away from positions of trust and responsibility within their own country
That British civil servants completely lacked any knowledge of English legal primaries
That foreign bureaucrats completely refused to consume food cooked by upper castes
That the civil service exam required candidates to hold technical degrees from Sanskrit colleges
oh: कि अपने ही देश में विश्वास और जिम्मेदारी के पदों से दूर रखकर भारतीयों के साथ भारी भेदभाव किया जा रहा था
कि ब्रिटिश सिविल सेवकों में अंग्रेजी कानूनी प्राथमिकताओं के ज्ञान का पूरी तरह से अभाव था
कि विदेशी नौकरशाहों ने उच्च जातियों द्वारा पकाए गए भोजन का उपभोग करने से पूरी तरह इनकार कर दिया
कि सिविल सेवा परीक्षा के लिए उम्मीदवारों के पास संस्कृत कॉलेजों से तकनीकी डिग्री होना आवश्यक था
e:
Civil services ke Indianization ke liye Moderates ne economic aur administrative grounds ke sath-sath strong moral arguments bhi present kiye the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Higher administrative services (jaise ICS) ke Indianization ke liye Moderates ki demand ke teen major grounds the: economic (European officers ki huge salaries aur pensions se wealth drain hoti thi), administrative (foreign officers Indian ground realities se disconnected the), aur moral: ki qualified Indians ko unke apne hi desh mein trust, authority aur responsibility ke posts se systematically exclude karke unke sath blatant racial discrimination kiya ja raha tha, jo unke national character ko degrade kar raha tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because British officers Haileybury jaise institutes se trained the aur unke paas English law ka knowledge tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Caste-based food preferences ka argument nationalist leaders ne kabhi use nahi kiya.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because ICS exam syllabus European classics aur Greco-Roman subjects ke favor mein biased tha, Sanskrit degrees ke favor mein nahi.

qe: The early nationalists fiercely criticized the aggressive foreign policy executed by the colonial government. Which military campaigns did they oppose due to the heavy financial burden they placed on the Indian treasury?
qh: शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादियों ने औपनिवेशिक सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई आक्रामक विदेश नीति की तीखी आलोचना की। भारतीय खजाने पर भारी वित्तीय बोझ डालने के कारण उन्होंने किन सैन्य अभियानों का विरोध किया?
oe: The deployment of marine shipping routes to trade with South American states
The structural cross-border migrations entering French Pondicherry borders
The setting up of high-cost meteorological observatories inside polar biomes
The annexation of Burma, attacks on Afghanistan, and suppression of tribals in the North-West
oh: दक्षिण अमेरिकी राज्यों के साथ व्यापार करने के लिए समुद्री शिपिंग मार्गों की तैनाती
फ्रांसीसी पांडिचेरी सीमाओं में प्रवेश करने वाले संरचनात्मक सीमा पार प्रवासन
ध्रुवीय बायोम के अंदर उच्च लागत वाली मौसम संबंधी वेधशालाओं की स्थापना
बर्मा का विलय, अफगानिस्तान पर हमले और उत्तर-पश्चिम में आदिवासियों का दमन
e:
British imperialism ke aggressive frontier wars aur unke karan Indian revenue par aane wale financial strain ka Moderates ne virodh kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because South American trade route deployment koi 19th-century military campaign issue nahi tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because French Pondicherry borders ke cross-border migration ka issue is military critique ka hissa nahi tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because polar biome observatories ek completely fictitious option hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because Early nationalist leaders aur Indian National Congress ne British imperialist military policies ka fiercely virodh kiya. Unhone Upper Burma ke annexation (1885), costly Afghan military expeditions, aur North-Western frontier par tribal suppression ke aggressive wars ko heavily criticize kiya. Unka point tha ki Indian taxpayers ka paisa public welfare (jaise education, sanitation, famine relief) par kharch hone ke bajaye British imperial expansion ke liye drain kiya ja raha hai.

qe: What programmatic limitation characterizes the democratic base of the Moderate nationalist movement between 1885 and 1905?
qh: 1885 और 1905 के बीच नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादी आंदोलन के लोकतांत्रिक आधार (democratic base) की कौन सी कार्यक्रम संबंधी सीमा विशेषता थी?
oe: They completely refused to publish any journals or print materials in vernacular languages
They aligned their platform entirely with the conservative orthodox groups of the Dharma Sabha
They failed to widen the democratic base of the movement by not including the masses, especially women, and not demanding universal voting rights
They strictly restricted their membership parameters to wealthy Parsi corporate managers exclusively
oh: उन्होंने देशी भाषाओं में किसी भी पत्रिका या मुद्रित सामग्री को प्रकाशित करने से पूरी तरह इनकार कर दिया
उन्होंने अपने मंच को पूरी तरह से धर्म सभा के रूढ़िवादी समूहों के साथ संरेखित किया
वे जनता, विशेषकर महिलाओं को शामिल न करके और सार्वभौमिक मतदान अधिकारों की मांग न करके आंदोलन के लोकतांत्रिक आधार को व्यापक बनाने में विफल रहे
उन्होंने अपनी सदस्यता मापदंडों को विशेष रूप से केवल अमीर पारसी कॉर्पोरेट प्रबंधकों तक ही सीमित रखा
e:
Early nationalist movement ne national awakening to create ki, lekin iska mass base aur social inclusion initially kafi narrow raha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Nationalist leaders vernacular newspapers (jaise Kesari, Bengalee) mein actively publish karte the.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Congress ek modern, secular platform tha, Dharma Sabha jaise orthodox bodies se aligned nahi tha.

• Option 3 is Correct because Moderate era (1885–1905) ki main programmatic limitation iska narrow social base tha. Ye movement primarily urban, English-educated middle-class elites (lawyers, doctors, journalists, professors) tak limited tha. Moderates uneducated rural masses, peasants aur industrial workers ki political capacity par full faith nahi karte the, women ko mass scale par organize nahi kiya, aur us stage par universal adult franchise ki demand bhi nahi uthayi thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Congress membership sabhi communities (Hindus, Muslims, Parsis, Christians) ke liye open thi.

qe: The protection and defense of civil rights—including the right to free speech, thought, and a free press—became an integral part of the national struggle following public outrage over which historical event in 1897?
qh: मुक्त भाषण, विचार और स्वतंत्र प्रेस के अधिकार सहित नागरिक अधिकारों की सुरक्षा और रक्षा, 1897 में किस ऐतिहासिक घटना पर जनता के भारी आक्रोश के बाद राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष का एक अभिन्न हिस्सा बन गई?
oe: The permanent seizure of James Augustus Hickey's printing press equipment by a magistrate's order
The administrative shutdown of the newly established Central Hindu College at Benaras
The legal passage of the Child Marriage Restraint Act raising the marriageable age parameters
The arrest of Lokmanya Tilak and several other journalists alongside the deportation of the Natu brothers without a trial
oh: एक मजिस्ट्रेट के आदेश से जेम्स ऑगस्टस हिक्की के प्रिंटिंग प्रेस उपकरण की स्थायी जब्ती
बनारस में नव स्थापित सेंट्रल हिंदू कॉलेज का प्रशासनिक बंद होना
विवाह योग्य आयु मापदंडों को बढ़ाने वाले बाल विवाह निरोधक अधिनियम का कानूनी पारित होना
बिना मुकदमे के नातू बंधुओं के निर्वासन के साथ-साथ लोकमान्य तिलक और कई अन्य पत्रकारों की गिरफ्तारी
e:
1897 ke repressive colonial administrative actions ne civil liberties aur press freedom ko freedom struggle ka core agenda bana diya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because James Augustus Hicky ke Bengal Gazette press ko 1782 mein Warren Hastings ke tenure mein seize kiya gaya tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Central Hindu College Benaras mein Annie Besant dwara 1898 mein establish kiya gaya tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Child Marriage Restraint Act (Sarda Act) 1929 mein pass hua tha.

• Option 4 is Correct because 1897 mein Poona mein Chapekar brothers dwara Plague Commissioner Rand ke assassination ke baad British government ne heavy repression start kiya. Bal Gangadhar Tilak aur doosre editors ko Section 124A IPC (sedition) ke under arrest karke imprison kiya gaya, aur Natu brothers (Damodar aur Wasudeo) ko Regulation XXV of 1827 ke under bina trial ke arbitrarily deport kar diya gaya. Is widespread crackdown ke against pure desh mein outrage fail gaya aur free speech, press freedom aur civil liberties ki defense national movement ka ek permanent agenda ban gayi.

qe: A tracking route charts a right-angled triangular configuration. A survey vehicle drives 48 km South from station O, and then changes course to move 14 km West to reach research point R. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to R.
qh: एक कार स्टेशन O से 48 किमी दक्षिण की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पश्चिम की ओर 14 किमी जाकर बिंदु R पर पहुँचती है। O से R की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
oe: 50 km
54 km
62 km
52 km
e:
Straight-line displacement calculate karne ke liye perpendicular directional vectors par Pythagoras Theorem apply kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because Ye path ek right-angled triangle construct karta hai jisme southward displacement ($a = 48	ext{ km}$) aur westward displacement ($b = 14	ext{ km}$) do perpendicular sides hain. Starting point O se endpoint R tak direct straight-line displacement is triangle ka hypotenuse ($c$) hoga. Pythagorean Theorem apply karne par:

$$c = sqrt{a^2 + b^2} = sqrt{48^2 + 14^2} = sqrt{2304 + 196} = sqrt{2500} = 50	ext{ km}$$

• Option 2 is Incorrect because 54 km mathematical calculation ke hisaab se galat value hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 62 km total scalar distance traveled ($48 + 14 = 62	ext{ km}$) hai, shortest straight-line displacement nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 52 km Pythagoras theorem ka correct solution nahi hai.

qe: In an ecosystem productivity tracking survey mapping energy parameters, if the measured Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) is 54,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 34,000 units, calculate the energy spent during metabolic respiration (R).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि मापी गई सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 54,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 34,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
oe: 40,000 units
20,000 units
16,000 units
88,000 units
e:
Ecosystem energetics mein primary productivity aur respiratory losses ek fundamental stoichiometric balance equation follow karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because 40,000 units computational roop se galat calculation hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Ecological energetics mein Gross Primary Productivity (GPP), Net Primary Productivity (NPP), aur autotrophic Respiration loss ($R$) ke beech standard relation is formula se define hota hai:

$$	ext{NPP} = 	ext{GPP} - R$$

Respiration loss ($R$) calculate karne ke liye equation ko rearrange karne par:

$$R = 	ext{GPP} - 	ext{NPP} = 54,000 - 34,000 = 20,000	ext{ units}$$

• Option 3 is Incorrect because 16,000 units is subtraction problem ka correct result nahi hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because 88,000 units GPP aur NPP ka sum ($54,000 + 34,000$) represent karta hai.

qe: Political associations in the first half of the nineteenth century differed structurally from those formed in the second half. What element dominated these early associations?
qh: उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी के पूर्वार्ध (first half) के राजनीतिक संगठन उत्तरार्ध में बने संगठनों से संरचनात्मक रूप से भिन्न थे। इन शुरुआती संगठनों में किस तत्व का दबदबा था?
oe: The newly educated middle class comprising lawyers, doctors, and teachers exclusively
Wealthy and aristocratic elements who were local or regional in character
Unorganized landless agricultural ryots from backward subdivisions
Industrial working-class labor fronts managed by trade unions
oh: नया शिक्षित मध्यम वर्ग जिसमें विशेष रूप से वकील, डॉक्टर और शिक्षक शामिल थे
अमीर और कुलीन वर्ग जिनका चरित्र स्थानीय या क्षेत्रीय था
पिछड़े उप-प्रभागों के असंगठित भूमिहीन कृषि रैयत (किसान)
ट्रेड यूनियनों द्वारा प्रबंधित औद्योगिक श्रमिक वर्ग के मजदूर मोर्चे
e:
Nineteenth-century India mein early political bodies primarily landed aristocrats aur wealthy elites ke local class interests represent karti thin.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Educated middle class (lawyers, doctors, journalists, teachers) ka dominance 19th century ke second half (jaise Indian Association, Poona Sarvajanik Sabha) ke organizations mein start hua.

• Option 2 is Correct because 19th century ke first half (1800–1850s) mein bani political associations (jaise Landholders' Society 1838 aur British Indian Association 1851) wealthy landlords, merchant princes aur aristocratic elites ke dominance mein thin. Unka character local aur regional tha, aur unki working primarily British Parliament ko petitions bhejkar apne class privileges aur land rights ko safeguard karne tak limited thi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Landless peasants aur ryots is phase mein unorganized the aur early leadership mein absent the.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Industrial trade unions India mein 1920s ke baad organize hona shuru hui thin.

qe: What was the characteristic feature of the political associations that emerged in the second half of the nineteenth century in British India?
qh: ब्रिटिश भारत में उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध (second half) में उभरे राजनीतिक संगठनों की विशेषता क्या थी?
oe: They were secret religious revivalist fronts focused entirely on launching armed mutinies
They restricted their institutional participation exclusively to loyalist princely elites
They rejected any political propaganda or educational campaigns across rural areas
They were increasingly dominated by the educated middle class—lawyers, journalists, doctors, and teachers—with a wider perspective and larger agenda
oh: वे पूरी तरह से सशस्त्र विद्रोह शुरू करने पर केंद्रित गुप्त धार्मिक पुनरुत्थानवादी मोर्चे थे
उन्होंने अपनी संस्थागत भागीदारी को विशेष रूप से वफादार रियासती अभिजात वर्ग तक ही सीमित रखा
उन्होंने ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में किसी भी राजनीतिक प्रचार या शैक्षिक अभियानों को खारिज कर दिया
वे व्यापक दृष्टिकोण और बड़े एजेंडे के साथ शिक्षित मध्यम वर्ग—वकीलों, पत्रकारों, डॉक्टरों और शिक्षकों—के वर्चस्व में थे
e:
Post-1860s ke phase mein Indian nationalism ka leadership base aristocratic zamindaron se shift hokar educated middle class ke paas aa gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Ye associations open, peaceful aur constitutional methods se kaam karti thin, secret armed mutinies se nahi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Loyalist elites tak limited rehna 19th century ke first half ke associations ka feature tha.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because New associations ne district towns mein branches khol kar actively public opinion mobilize kiya tha.

• Option 4 is Correct because 19th century ke second half (post-1860s) mein political leadership landed aristocracy se shift hokar modern Western-educated middle class—lawyers, journalists, professors aur doctors—ke haath mein aa gayi. Poona Sarvajanik Sabha (1867), Indian Association (1876), Madras Mahajan Sabha (1884), aur Bombay Presidency Association (1885) jaise organizations ka perspective all-India tha, aur unka agenda civil rights, administrative reforms aur economic critique jaise broader national issues par focused tha.

qe: The British Indian Association, formed in 1851 by the merger of older groups, submitted a long petition to the British Parliament demanding specific fiscal reforms. Which tax relief did they demand?
qh: 1851 में पुराने समूहों के विलय से बने ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन ने ब्रिटिश संसद को एक लंबी याचिका भेजी थी। उन्होंने किस विशिष्ट कर राहत (tax relief) की मांग की थी?
oe: The absolute elimination of all land revenue collections across Bengal permanently
Imposition of an entry transit tax on all British machine-made textile shipments
Abolition of salt duty, abkari (excise) duty, and stamp duties
Levying a high progressive income tax on poor subsistence cultivators
oh: पूरे बंगाल में स्थायी रूप से सभी भू-राजस्व संग्रहों का पूर्ण उन्मूलन
सभी ब्रिटिश मशीन-निर्मित कपड़ा शिपमेंट पर प्रवेश पारगमन कर लगाना
नमक शुल्क, आबकारी (abkari) शुल्क और स्टांप शुल्क का उन्मूलन
गरीब निर्वाह किसानों पर उच्च प्रगतिशील आयकर लगाना
e:
1853 Charter Act ke renewal ke sandarbh mein British Indian Association ne oppressive fiscal duties ke abolition ke liye petition submit ki thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Association ne Permanent Settlement ko support kiya tha aur uske extension ki baat ki thi, land revenue complete abolish karne ki nahi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because British textiles par protective transit tax ki demand 1851 mein nahi uthayi gayi thi; tariff protection ki demands late 19th century mein shuru hui thin.

• Option 3 is Correct because 1851 mein British Indian Association ne Charter Act of 1853 ke aane se pehle British Parliament ko ek detailed petition bheji thi. Is petition mein unhone fiscal relief demand karte hue oppressive Salt Duty, Abkari (liquor aur spirits par excise duty), aur Stamp Duties ko abolish karne ki specific demand rakhi thi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Association cultivators par new taxes lagane ke bajaye tax burden reduce karne ke favor mein thi.

qe: Which pre-Congress organization is recognized as the most important forerunner of the Indian National Congress, even sponsoring an All India Conference in 1883 before formally merging with the Congress in 1886?
qh: 1886 में कांग्रेस में औपचारिक रूप से विलय होने से पहले 1883 में एक अखिल भारतीय सम्मेलन को प्रायोजित करने वाले संगठन को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अग्रदूत माना जाता है?
oe: The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
The Indian League
The Indian Association of Calcutta
The British Indian Association
oh: द पूना सार्वजनिक सभा (The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha)
द इंडियन लीग (The Indian League)
इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता (The Indian Association of Calcutta)
द ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन (The British Indian Association)
e:
Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose ki sanstha ne all-India political movement aur Indian National Conference ka successfully gathan kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Poona Sarvajanik Sabha primarily Maharashtra aur Western India mein active thi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Indian League (1875) short-lived thi aur Indian Association ne ise jaldi supersede kar diya.

• Option 3 is Correct because The Indian Association of Calcutta (jise 1876 mein Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose ne banaya tha) ko Indian National Congress ka most significant precursor aur forerunner mana jata hai. Isne pan-Indian political network build kiya, ICS age reduction ke against civil service movement lead kiya, aur December 1883 mein Calcutta mein First All India National Conference organize ki. Iski second conference December 1885 mein hui aur December 1886 ke Calcutta session mein ye formally Indian National Congress ke sath merge ho gayi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because British Indian Association (1851) conservative aur landlord-dominated association bani rahi.

qe: The early Moderate nationalists utilized a distinct political strategy to put forward public demands before the colonial state. Critics and neo-nationalists later mockingly referred to this strategy as the method of:
qh: शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने औपनिवेशिक राज्य के सामने सार्वजनिक मांगें रखने के लिए एक अलग राजनीतिक रणनीति का इस्तेमाल किया। आलोचकों और नव-राष्ट्रवादियों ने बाद में इस रणनीति को मज़ाक में किसकी पद्धति कहा?
oe: Armed guerrilla warfare and secret structural boycotts
Spontaneous mass baseline non-cooperation strikes
Universal adult franchise tracking and civil disobedience
Prayer and petition through constitutional agitation
oh: सशस्त्र गुरिल्ला युद्ध और गुप्त संरचनात्मक बहिष्कार
सहज जन आधारभूत गैर-सहयोग हड़तालें
सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार ट्रैकिंग और सविनय अवज्ञा
संवैधानिक आंदोलन के माध्यम से प्रार्थना और याचिका (Prayer and petition)
e:
Early Congress leaders ne colonial rule ke daayre mein constitutional agitation aur petitions par aadharit karyapranali apnayi thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Armed guerrilla warfare revolutionary underground groups ka method tha, Moderates ka nahi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Mass non-cooperation strategy Mahatma Gandhi ke time develop hui.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Civil disobedience movement Congress ne 1930 mein adopt kiya tha.

• Option 4 is Correct because Early Moderate nationalists (1885–1905) ki political strategy entirely colonial law ke boundaries ke andar constitutional agitation par based thi. Unka methodology resolutions pass karna, formal memoranda bhejna, delegations aur petitions submit karna tha (jise 3Ps: 'Prayers, Petitions, and Protests' kaha jata hai). Baad ke militant nationalist leaders (jaise Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Bipin Chandra Pal, aur Lala Lajpat Rai) ne is moderate strategy ko mock karte hue 'Political Mendicancy' (राजनीतिक भिक्षावृत्ति) ka label diya tha.

qe: The 'Indian National Conference', which held two successful pan-Indian sessions in 1883 and 1885 with representatives from all major towns of India, had which two leaders as its main architects?
qh: 1883 और 1885 में भारत के सभी प्रमुख शहरों के प्रतिनिधियों के साथ दो सफल अखिल भारतीय सत्र आयोजित करने वाले 'इंडियन नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस' (Indian National Conference) के मुख्य वास्तुकार कौन दो नेता थे?
oe: W.C. Bonnerjee and A.O. Hume
Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha
Badruddin Tyabji and Pherozshah Mehta
oh: डब्ल्यू. सी. बनर्जी और ए. ओ. ह्यूम
सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी और आनंद मोहन बोस
दादाभाई नौरोजी और दिनशा वाचा
बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी और फिरोजशाह मेहता
e:
Calcutta mein 1883 aur 1885 mein pan-Indian delegates ke conferences organize karne ka shrey Bengal ke middle-class nationalist leaders ko jata hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Bonnerjee aur Hume ne December 1885 mein Bombay mein INC organize ki thi.

• Option 2 is Correct because Indian National Conference ko Indian Association of Calcutta ke through Surendranath Banerjea aur Ananda Mohan Bose ne lead aur organize kiya tha. Isne Calcutta mein do historic sessions hold kiye: first December 1883 mein aur second December 1885 mein, jisme all-India level ke political delegates shamil hue the. Kyunki second conference December 1885 mein Bombay ke first INC session ke sath coincide kar gayi thi, isliye Surendranath Banerjea Bombay session attend nahi kar paye the; baad mein December 1886 mein National Conference INC ke sath merge ho gayi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Naoroji aur Wacha Bombay aur London political platforms ke leaders the.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Tyabji aur Mehta Bombay Presidency Association ke key organizers the.

qe: In the history of the Indian National Congress, who holds the distinction of being elected thrice as the President of its annual national sessions during the early phase?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के इतिहास में, प्रारंभिक चरण के दौरान इसके वार्षिक राष्ट्रीय सत्रों के अध्यक्ष के रूप में तीन बार चुने जाने का गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
oe: Surendranath Banerjea
W.C. Bonnerjee
Badruddin Tyabji
Dadabhai Naoroji
oh: सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी
डब्ल्यू. सी. बनर्जी
बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी
दादाभाई नौरोजी
e:
Grand Old Man of India Dadabhai Naoroji ne Congress ke early formative aur transitional phases mein teen alag-alag sessions ki adhyakshata ki thi.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Surendranath Banerjea ne do baar preside kiya tha (1895 Poona aur 1902 Ahmedabad).

• Option 2 is Incorrect because W.C. Bonnerjee ne INC ko do baar preside kiya tha (1885 Bombay aur 1892 Allahabad).

• Option 3 is Incorrect because Badruddin Tyabji ne ek baar preside kiya tha (1887 Madras session).

• Option 4 is Correct because Dadabhai Naoroji ('Grand Old Man of India') ko Indian National Congress ke early phase mein teen baar (thrice) President elect kiya gaya tha: 1886 Session (Calcutta, second INC session); 1893 Session (Lahore, British House of Commons ke first Indian MP elect hone ke baad); aur 1906 Session (Calcutta, jahan INC ke platform se pehli baar 'Swaraj' ko official goal declare kiya gaya tha).

qe: A major programmatic aim of the Indian National Congress in its initial stage was focused on political workers from different regions. What was this objective?
qh: अपने प्रारंभिक चरण में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का एक प्रमुख कार्यक्रम संबंधी उद्देश्य विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के राजनीतिक कार्यकर्ताओं पर केंद्रित था। यह उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To restrict political activity tracking parameters strictly to the city of Calcutta
To legally force all local workers to exclusively adopt English-medium speech models
To promote friendly relations among nationalist political workers from different parts of the country
To systematically train workers to initiate armed industrial factory strikes in Bombay
oh: राजनीतिक गतिविधि ट्रैकिंग मापदंडों को सख्ती से कलकत्ता शहर तक सीमित करना
सभी स्थानीय कार्यकर्ताओं को विशेष रूप से अंग्रेजी माध्यम के भाषण मॉडल अपनाने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर करना
देश के विभिन्न हिस्सों के राष्ट्रवादी राजनीतिक कार्यकर्ताओं के बीच मैत्रीपूर्ण संबंधों को बढ़ावा देना
बॉम्बे में सशस्त्र औद्योगिक कारखाने की हड़ताल शुरू करने के लिए श्रमिकों को व्यवस्थित रूप से प्रशिक्षित करना
e:
Congress ke pratham adhivardhan mein national integration aur inter-provincial political networking ko primary agenda banaya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Congress ek pan-Indian organization thi, iska scope Calcutta tak restricted nahi tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Congress ne sabhi delegates aur workers ke liye koi coercive English-only rule impose nahi kiya tha.

• Option 3 is Correct because 1885 ke first Congress session mein President W.C. Bonnerjee ne INC ke core objectives outline kiye the, jinme foremost aims the: National Fraternity (Desh ke different provinces aur presidencies ke dedicated political aur social workers ke beech personal contacts aur friendly relations develop karna); National Unity (Provincial, religious aur regional prejudices ko eradicate karke unified Indian national identity consolidate karna); aur Major administrative matters par all-India level par common, mature public demands formulate aur document karna.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Armed industrial factory strikes early Congress ke objectives ka hissa nahi the.

qe: How did Moderate leaders like Pherozshah Mehta and Gopal Krishna Gokhale utilize the Imperial Legislative Council before 1892 despite its complete lack of real official power?
qh: फिरोजशाह मेहता और गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले जैसे नरमपंथी नेताओं ने 1892 से पहले इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का उपयोग कैसे किया, जबकि इसके पास वास्तविक आधिकारिक शक्ति की कमी थी?
oe: They completely boycotted the council sessions and refused to accept any nominations from the Crown
They systematically endorsed every restrictive government proposal without any critical scrutiny
They transformed the councils into active forums for ventilating popular grievances, exposing bureaucratic defects, and raising basic economic issues
They used the council rooms to stage violent, armed non-cooperation agitations against the Viceroy
oh: उन्होंने परिषद के सत्रों का पूरी तरह से बहिष्कार किया और क्राउन से किसी भी नामांकन को स्वीकार करने से इनकार कर दिया
उन्होंने बिना किसी आलोचनात्मक जांच के हर प्रतिबंधात्मक सरकारी प्रस्ताव का व्यवस्थित रूप से समर्थन किया
उन्होंने परिषदों को जनता की शिकायतों को उठाने, नौकरशाही की कमियों को उजागर करने और बुनियादी आर्थिक मुद्दों को उठाने के लिए सक्रिय मंचों में बदल दिया
उन्होंने वायसराय के खिलाफ हिंसक, सशस्त्र असहयोग आंदोलन करने के लिए परिषद कक्षों का उपयोग किया
e:
Moderate nationalists ne legislative councils ki institutional limitations ke bawajood unhe national political education ka mukhya manch banaya tha.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Moderates ne boycott karne ke bajaye councils mein actively participate kiya tha.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Moderates ne restrictive government bills (jaise Official Secrets Act, Universities Act) ko systematically aur vigorously oppose kiya tha.

• Option 3 is Correct because Bhale hi 1892 Act se pehle aur baad mein legislative councils ke paas real official powers minimal thin aur official majorities dominate karti thin, lekin Pherozshah Mehta, Gopal Krishna Gokhale, Dinshaw Wacha, aur Surendranath Banerjea jaise nationalist leaders ne council chambers ka brilliant use kiya. Unhone in councils ko national forums mein transform kar diya taaki colonial budgets ko cross-examine kiya ja sake, bureaucratic expenditure ko expose kiya ja sake, agrarian distress aur high military expenditure ko openly criticize kiya ja sake, aur published speeches ke through public opinion ko educate kiya ja sake.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Nationalist council work parliamentary decorum aur constitutional debates ke through chalta tha, violence ke through nahi.
